name: Invoice paid WooCommerce orders and send packing orders to the warehouse
description: When a paid WooCommerce order arrives, issues the invoice in the accounting system and sends the packing order to the logistics warehouse. No AI is needed here.
shortDescription: When a WooCommerce order is paid, issue the invoice and send the packing order. No AI needed.
keyFeatures: Issues the invoice in your accounting system
Sends the packing order to the logistics warehouse
prerequisites: Accounting system with a REST API for invoices; replace REPLACE_WITH_ACCOUNTING_API
Warehouse or logistics provider with a REST API for packing orders; replace REPLACE_WITH_WAREHOUSE_API
idealFor: Small web shops that ship physical products through a fulfilment warehouse.
steps: Trigger: a new order in WooCommerce.
Check whether the order is paid.
Issue the invoice in the accounting system.
Send the packing order to the warehouse.
